title: Processing order events from a queue

concepts.description: A queue that retries until acknowledged may deliver the same message twice, so consumers must expect duplicates.
concepts.context: acks and requeues messages in onMessage()

concepts.description: Recording each handled event id under a unique constraint lets a consumer skip repeats instead of repeating side effects.
concepts.context: inserts the event id with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING before marking the order paid
